text: A muscular male with light brown skin, long blonde hair in a braid, and a square jaw. He wears a black necklace with a circular pendant and fur-trimmed armbands. Standing front-facing, bare-chested, arms at sides. Four views show him: frontal (most prominent), three-quarter front, side profile, and rear view—all nude except for the armbands and necklace. Hair is long, braided down back in some angles. Skin tone consistent across all panels.
